objective: Bring forty Mithril Bars and forty Iron Bars to Galvan the Ancient in Stranglethorn.

description: Many blacksmiths believe that mining and smithing are separate, independent jobs; but can there be blacksmithing without mining? Ah ha -- it is an impossibility! The accomplished blacksmith must also be an accomplished miner.
Show Galvan that you are capable, <name>. Bring me forty bars of iron and forty bars of mithril. For this, Galvan will teach you the ways of the ornate mithril pants!
progress: After such mining, your muscles bulge and your body aches!
completion: Your work ethic is impeccable, <name>! You are starting to understand the ways of Galvan mineralogy! Take this and learn from it all that you can.
